summary.caption: Wide cinematic fantasy panorama divided by a radiant portal, ancient organic wilderness on the left and a luminous advanced metropolis on the right, both worlds sharing one horizon, high detail, cohesive lighting and spectacular concept-art finish.

items.label: text
items.caption: Elegant bright title floating high above the portal with generous tracking.

items.label: object
items.caption: Ancient enchanted forest realm filling the left half, monumental mossy trees, waterfalls, drifting fireflies and emerald morning mist flowing toward the centre.

items.label: object
items.caption: Dazzling far-future city filling the right half, slender illuminated towers, aerial transit trails and violet-blue evening haze flowing toward the centre.

items.label: object
items.caption: A tall circular portal of liquid golden light at the centre, clearly separating yet visually connecting the two environments, intricate floating runes around its rim.

items.label: character
items.caption: A small cloaked traveller seen from behind stepping through the central portal, one foot in each world, fabric swept by energy, full body.
